_npc_system_info: Tests NPC→enemy escalation when players attack prisoners/neutrals
_comment_initial_npcs: Start with PRISONER NPCs (previously de-escalated enemies) to test escalation

initial_npcs.name: Captured Raider Vex
initial_npcs.description: Disarmed raider, hands bound, but still defiant. Has intel about smuggling operations. If threatened with violence, may resist or try to escape.

initial_npcs.name: Wounded Raider Kess
initial_npcs.description: Badly wounded raider (10 HP remaining), compliant and terrified. Surrendered to save their life. If attacked, will try to flee or defend themselves despite injuries.

initial_npcs.name: Neutral Informant Dara
initial_npcs.description: Informant who agreed to cooperate in exchange for clemency. Has weapons but hasn't used them. If betrayed or attacked, will defend themselves aggressively.

scenario.situation: You have three prisoners/informants secured for questioning: a defiant raider (Vex), a wounded compliant prisoner (Kess), and a wary informant who agreed to cooperate (Dara). Your mission is to extract intel about smuggling routes. But if you push too hard, use excessive force, or betray agreements, these NPCs may turn hostile.

_scenario_hint: DM should trigger escalations if players: attack prisoners, use torture/excessive force, break deals with informants, or threaten their lives. Escalation converts NPC back to enemy with preserved agent_id. Prisoners should plead, comply, or hide initially. Informant should be cooperative but cautious. Test that stable agent_ids are preserved across de-escalation→escalation cycles.

_test_notes.purpose: Test NPC→enemy escalation when players attack or betray NPCs
expected_escalation_triggers: Player breaks deal with informant → Escalation (neutral → enemy)
DM escalates wounded prisoner if attacked while helpless
skills_to_test: Combat × Brawl (if escalation happens, physical restraint)
success_criteria: At least one NPC escalates to enemy when attacked/betrayed
Escalations logged via structured output (escalations field)
No keyword detection (escalation via structured output only)
Escalated enemies can attack players using enemy agent system

verification.console_output: Look for DM narration about resistance/fighting back
verification.jsonl: escalation events with preserved agent_id, combat_action from escalated NPCs

mission_objectives.description: Extract smuggling route intel from at least one prisoner
